project: Make development understandable to the project owner

capabilities.name: Understand progress
capabilities.outcome: Explain supported result, gaps and next decision.

capabilities.name: Establish usefulness
capabilities.outcome: Assess emitted installed outputs and owner comprehension.

artifacts.name: Existing authority and evidence
artifacts.source_of_truth: Existing direction, task and review owners
artifacts.lifecycle: Read-only inputs; preserve reviewed identities and historical decisions.

artifacts.name: Pilot and ownership decisions
artifacts.lifecycle: Proposed until owner clarity checkpoint passes.

artifacts.name: Planning and brief guidance
artifacts.lifecycle: Candidate source; installed behavior requires later qualification.

artifacts.name: Reporting guidance and navigation
artifacts.source_of_truth: Owning source skills and existing guides
artifacts.lifecycle: Versioned guidance; each emitted report retains its own scope and age.

artifacts.name: Qualification evidence and feedback
artifacts.source_of_truth: T-004 result/evidence record and owner feedback
artifacts.lifecycle: Bound to candidate identity; preserve corrections and unrun gaps.

interfaces.name: Authority to explanation
interfaces.contract: See plan section 3: preserve purpose, authority and uncertainty; flag conflicts.

interfaces.name: Evidence to result explanation
interfaces.contract: See plan sections 2-3: reported checks and independent disposition stay distinct; stale or missing proof cannot become current success.

interfaces.name: Source to disposable installation
interfaces.contract: See plan sections 3 and 5: canonical installer, exact candidate identity, no active-session refresh; missing behavior evidence remains incomplete.

invariants.statement: Owner understands the opening without decoding IDs or reading technical appendices.
invariants.verification: Owner comprehension checks in T-001 and T-004.

invariants.statement: Preserve source identity, authority, limitations and planned/reported/independently supported distinctions.
Retain required preparation, independent discovery, separate acceptance and correction duties; approved plans are not mutable status stores.
No duplicate mandatory overview, status ledger or narrative contract.
Qualification binds source and installed versions without refreshing the active installation.
invariants.verification: Disposable installation and fresh-consumer evidence in T-004.

flows.name: Understand intent
flows.trigger: Owner asks what is being built
flows.terminal_outcome: Owner explains result, task contribution and next useful proof.

steps.action: Read authority and prepare pilot or revised planning explanation
steps.state_transition: Proposed example -> owner clarity decision; unclear remains proposed

steps.action: Read opening and task contribution; identify unresolved questions
steps.state_transition: Missing direction -> explicit question, not invented purpose

flows.name: Understand progress
flows.trigger: Work completes, fails or is interrupted
flows.terminal_outcome: Owner sees supported result, remaining gap and next actor/decision.

steps.action: Use existing evidence to explain reported changes and separate independent disposition
steps.state_transition: Completion claim -> scoped independent decision, or incomplete/rejected

steps.action: Navigate to current report and assess next action
steps.state_transition: Changed bytes -> prior verdict historical; uncertain latest remains unknown

flows.name: Qualify usefulness
flows.terminal_outcome: Qualified candidate or correction route with explicit remaining gaps.

steps.action: Install disposable candidate and produce outputs from supplied inputs
steps.state_transition: Candidate -> observed outputs or explicit unrun gap

steps.action: Check clarity, accuracy, safeguards and disposition
steps.state_transition: Observed candidate -> supported advance decision or correction; no automatic acceptance

tasks.title: Try an understandable example
tasks.outcome: Owner can explain this change from a concrete pilot opening.
tasks.integration_boundary: Owner answers the five reading questions from the example; unresolved confusion blocks T-002.
tasks.task_planner_context: Use this documentation change; hypothetical result text stays labeled. Reuse normal task evidence and record ownership decisions. See plan section 5.

tasks.title: Connect plans and tasks to purpose
tasks.outcome: Planning guidance makes result and task contribution understandable.
tasks.integration_boundary: Supplied small and multi-task packages yield accurate openings and retain required technical/preparation detail.
tasks.task_planner_context: Requires actual owner clarity checkpoint, not pilot-file existence. Reuse direction trace; change adjacent skills only for demonstrated compatibility gaps. See plan section 5.

tasks.title: Explain results and next action
tasks.outcome: Existing result and acceptance records expose supported progress and remaining decisions.
tasks.integration_boundary: Successful, interrupted, rejected and incomplete-evidence cases explain result, limits and next actor without unsupported acceptance.
tasks.task_planner_context: Keep implementer claims, independent discovery and acceptance distinct; retain identity fields, findings and approved plan immutability. See plan section 5.

tasks.title: Qualify the complete reading experience
tasks.outcome: Installed candidate outputs demonstrate clarity and accuracy, with honest gaps.
tasks.integration_boundary: Fresh installed consumers emit source-faithful outputs; wrong claims are rejected; owner confirms comprehension; required independent reviews remain separate.
tasks.task_planner_context: Inspect existing coverage and installer surfaces; reuse fixtures. Model-consuming checks need prior approval. Never refresh active installation. Record candidate identities and unrun evidence. See plan sections 5-6.
